items.description:
Will Consulting is a digitalisation consultancy that helps organisations work through the cultural, operational and technology changes of digital transformation. Its services cover strategy implementation, where an operating model keeps day-to-day activities aligned with strategic objectives, and enterprise architecture, which standardises IT infrastructure around business goals. The firm also consolidates service offerings through enterprise service management, so departments such as IT, facilities and HR can give employees one support portal.

Its consulting looks at the why, how and what of each architecture decision, and its website lists ICT solutions alongside these services. The firm works with organisations that want structured guidance on their digital change rather than a single technology purchase. The business is based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, and suits companies that are reworking how their strategy, IT and service delivery connect.

WL CreationX is a graphic design studio in Pretoria that has been working since 2013, producing logos, brand identities, packaging, brochures, websites, photography and video for businesses across South Africa. Its branding work covers logo design, colour systems, typography and guidelines, and the studio documents brand colours, codes and fonts at handover. Print design, web design and marketing material are part of the same service.

The studio describes itself as a working team rather than a network of freelancers, so one designer stays with each project from brief to handover. Two rounds of changes are included in the quoted price, and print files are checked before anything goes to press. Clients can view finished work in the project showcase before committing. The studio is based in the Park Lane West building in Waterkloof Glen, and it suits businesses in Pretoria and wider Gauteng that want their identity and marketing designed under one roof.

items.description:
Wonderboom Car Service is an auto repair workshop operating from the Q4 Wongar petrol station on Braam Pretorius Street in Wonderboom. It holds a 5-star MIWA grading and is a long-standing member of the Retail Motor Industry, and it offers minor and major car servicing as well as problem solving for vehicle faults. The workshop also works with all major extended warranty providers, which makes it easier to claim repairs under those policies.

A free drop-off service within a 5km radius is available for customers who cannot bring their vehicle in, and the RMI dispute resolution mechanism applies if a customer is unhappy with the outcome. Its more than 300 Google reviews are broadly positive about the service. The business is based in Wonderboom, Pretoria, and suits motorists who want servicing, repairs and warranty-backed work from a workshop with a formal grading.

items.description:
Xenia Pharmaceutical is a contract manufacturer of stock remedies and farm feeds based in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion. It makes pharmaceutical and nutraceutical liquids, ointments, pastes, gels, aerosols and powders, and it offers liquid filling, ointment and gel filling, powder filling, nutraceutical powder mixing and third-party packing. Research and development support is part of the service range.

The company says its management system meets local and international standards, including ISO 9001:2015, and that compliance is monitored through process markers and internal audits. Its stated aims include reliable, high-quality products delivered within agreed timeframes and meeting GMP standards. It suits brands and farm-feed businesses that need a manufacturer to produce or fill products to a documented quality system.

items.description:
XS Health is a South African health and wellness company that develops and sells supplement brands, including Noolit, Climux, ViralMed, Vita G, VitaleFemme, VitaleMen, Relevoderm, ZaFluMed, ProBio and Slimz. Its products are built on what the company calls the science of nature, using natural extracts in suitable potencies and carefully designed formulations. Each range is developed by a team that includes pharmacists, dietitians and research and regulatory experts.

The company traces its beginnings to 2006, when a pharmacist began researching natural extracts within complementary medicine, and it says it focuses on ethical manufacturing of high-potency products. Its ranges are aimed at people who want to improve their health and wellbeing without relying only on conventional medicines. The business is based at the Bio Park Building in Lynnwood, Pretoria, and suits adults looking for natural supplements across several health needs.

Xtreme Events, trading as Xtreme Promotions Sound and Lighting, has produced events since 1986, supplying DJs, sound, lighting, LED screens, staging and camera crews for weddings, corporate functions, festivals, school revues, concerts, product launches and matric farewells. Its wedding packages include sound and lights in the price, and clients can pencil in a date online before the team confirms it by phone. For larger productions, the crew designs the rig and quotes from a brief.

The company says it has been recommended at more than 38 venues, and its gallery shows real bookings rather than stock images. Its work has taken it to venues in Gauteng, the North West, Mpumalanga, Limpopo and KwaZulu-Natal, so it suits couples, corporate planners and event organisers who want one crew for sound, light and stage. The business is based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, and works across South Africa.

Yellow Professional Services SA is a Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform consultancy that implements, supports and builds business applications. Its services include Dynamics 365 implementation, deployment and migration from legacy Dynamics AX, GP, NAV and SL systems, along with custom applications for clients who need functionality that no existing product provides. The company describes its work as building code that builds business.

It says it has a track record in implementing and supporting Microsoft's Dynamics 365 and Power Platform applications, and that it sees projects through to the end. The team describes itself as curious about what lies beyond implementation. The company is based at Irene Corporate Corner in Centurion, with a presence also in the Isle of Man, and it suits organisations that want Dynamics or Power Platform systems built, supported and kept current.

items.reason: Research has only the Abacus Divisions homepage (search form and generic commercial property copy for Irene and Villiers) and no page about the firm itself. Founding year, divisions and track record in the current text are not confirmed by any source fetched.

items.description:
ABYX Chemical Company manufactures industrial and consumer cleaning products at its Waltloo base in Pretoria, and its factory shop sells the range directly to the public. Its products span bathroom, dishes, industrial, laundry, motor, outdoor and personal cleaning categories, and bulk cleaning chemicals are available for industrial use. The company is SABS ISO 9001 certified.

The business traces its roots to 1966, when a company was registered to make car polish and later developed dishwashing liquid, and it promotes reuse, refill and saving on its products. Its delivery areas include Pretoria, Polokwane, Middelburg, Rustenburg, Vereeniging, Welkom and Johannesburg, and products can be ordered online or found through its stockists list. The factory shop on Zasm Street in Waltloo suits anyone buying cleaning products in bulk or in retail quantities.

items.reason: Research has only the national Fidelity ADT contact page (solutions list, 24-hour contact line). Nothing describes the Centurion branch itself, so any description would be chain-level only.

items.description:
Advertising Solutions Web Design is a web design agency in Montana Park, Pretoria, building brochure and business websites, e-commerce stores, blog and magazine sites and custom business platforms. Its packages also include WordPress sites, web hosting, SEO and graphic design, and the agency says it offers affordable websites from R1000. It designs for a wide range of sectors, including legal services, healthcare, e-commerce and retail, construction and real estate, hospitality, education, financial services and automotive.

Packages can include up to one hour of support every month, and the agency hosts multiple websites and registers domains such as .co.za, .com and .org.za. It presents a professional website as a way to build trust, improve Google visibility and increase enquiries and bookings. The agency works with businesses across Gauteng and beyond, and it suits businesses that want a clear, affordable online presence built and looked after for them.

items.description:
All Storage is a family-owned self-storage business that has operated since 2004, offering household, business, student and personal storage. Its built units run from 3m x 3m up to 3m x 18m and larger, and it also sells mini shipping containers and offers open and covered parking bays. Moving services, long-distance moves and mobile storage units are available alongside the storage itself.

The business says affordability and security are at the heart of its facilities, which it describes as safe, clean and easy to access, with flexible terms and a variety of unit sizes. Its Pretoria branches include Lavender Road, Erras Street, Lintvelt Road and Betsie Road, and it also has a branch in George. Prices and availability vary between branches, so customers request a quote for the branch nearest them. This Annlin site on Lavender Road suits households and businesses that need extra space for a short or long period.

Allegra Healthcare Management is a South African software company that develops technology for healthcare providers, covering operations management and patient health management. Its products include AllegraCare, a platform for managing clinics and healthcare practices, HealthFindr, and VirtualCare, a telemedicine service that lets nurses, pharmacists and other practitioners consult a doctor from wherever they are. Workcare Wellness is also part of the range. The company says it serves more than 10,000 providers across Southern Africa and Dubai.

Its platform is organised by profession, so GPs, nurses, pharmacists, employee assistance practitioners and patients can each find the right product. The company describes its technology as modular, so solutions can be tailored to any healthcare practice. Its articles cover digitising the pharmacy and the changing role of pharmacists. The business is listed at Soutpansberg Road in Riviera, Pretoria, and suits clinics, pharmacies and healthcare groups that want practical digital tools.

Alumacon Glass and Aluminium Contractors is a Pretoria specialist in aluminium and glass products, manufacturing and installing windows, doors in single, double, pivot and sliding or folding styles, shopfronts, balustrades, louvres and security gates. Its team works closely with clients to design and manufacture products that meet specific requirements, from the brief through to installation.

The company says its portfolio includes thousands of completed projects and a team of more than 30 professionals who bring experience to every job. Its website shows examples under Our Projects, so prospective clients can see the work before they enquire. The business is at Unit 6, 49 Eland Street, Elandsfontein, Pretoria, and suits developers, contractors and homeowners who need custom aluminium and glass work built to a high standard.

Alutip is a Waltloo, Pretoria manufacturer of aluminium and steel truck load bodies and trailers, and the company says it has been at the forefront of this work for more than 17 years. Its range covers side tippers, end tippers, PUP trailers, semi-trailers, flat decks and beavertail flat decks, water and diesel tankers, pig and livestock trailers, rock dumpers, conveyors and feeder bins.

The products are designed to improve payload efficiency and reduce fuel consumption, and the company offers aluminium or steel options to suit each customer. Tailored solutions are available for unique operating needs, and quality assurance is applied to every product it delivers. Alutip is based at 320 Marks Street, and it suits transport operators, mining and agricultural hauliers, and fleet owners who need heavy-duty trailers built for specific loads.

AME Power Solutions is the alternative energy division of AME Technologies, with experience in designing, supplying, installing, integrating, commissioning and supporting power systems. Its services include off-grid solutions, commercial and industrial grid-tie solar, commercial energy storage, diesel hybrid solar systems that save fuel, and alternative energy for telecommunications. It also supplies battery solutions for aviation, military and medical markets.

The division sources its products from manufacturers such as Victron, SMA, BlueNova, Hoppecke, Huawei Solar and JA Solar, and designs systems for high performance and long life. It offers power system design consultation, certification of compliance for AC and DC systems, and on-site maintenance support. The division is based in Montana Park, Pretoria, and suits businesses and remote sites that need power systems designed, installed and maintained by one supplier.

items.description:
Apex Pump Solutions is a Pretoria-based supplier and installer of water pumps, with borehole pumps for deep well extraction, solar-powered pumps for off-grid use, submersible and booster pumps, and centrifugal, split case and vertical multi-stage pumps. Its heavy-duty range includes slurry pumps for mining, sewage pumps, and diesel and petrol pumps for remote sites. It also supplies accessories and works as a sourcing agent for specific pump requirements.

The company says it supplies domestic, agricultural, industrial and mining clients, and that it sources and delivers pump and water solutions across South Africa. Its website helps buyers identify the right pump by application, from horizontal multi-stage pumps to closed coupled pumps. The office is at Stormvoel Road in Kilner Park, Pretoria, and the business suits homeowners, farmers and industrial sites that need dependable pumping equipment.

items.reason: Research has only the national API Property Group homepage (industrial and commercial listings, 'since 1984') with no Pretoria or Centurion branch facts. The Centurion area-profile page is not in the research, so the business-node claims cannot be sourced.

items.description:
AppCentrix is a managed IT services company that turns IT operations data into real-time intelligence, with the aim of boosting performance, cutting costs and improving the customer experience. Its service catalogue includes CMDB as a service for a unified view of asset and configuration data, observability as a service for end-to-end visibility, automation as a service and AIOps as a service, which uses AI to find the causes of problems.

The company says it helps organisations move from reactive, manual IT operations to autonomous, self-healing systems, supported by expert insight services drawn from decades of targeted industry experience. Its approach is to bring tool sprawl into one data fabric and move from fragmented automation to strategic automation. The company is based in Irene, Centurion, and suits IT teams that want their operations to become more automated, predictable and easier to manage.

items.reason: The Aqua Express site was blocked by anti-bot protection (35 visible characters). The search results are about the band Aqua, an Adobe app and an unrelated plant-hire company, so no source describes this refill store.

items.description:
Arabest Solutions is a South African AI marketing company that helps businesses improve their visibility across search engines and AI platforms, including ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Claude and Perplexity. Its services combine search engine optimisation, answer engine optimisation, generative engine optimisation, social media marketing and AI-driven strategies, and it describes itself as a full-service digital marketing partner.

The agency aims to drive more qualified traffic to client websites, turn more enquiries into paying customers and build stronger engagement through consistent content and communication. Based in Montana, Pretoria, Arabest suits businesses that want to be found when customers search online, whether through a traditional search engine or an AI assistant.

items.description:
Ashkan Group is a nutritional health company in Olievenhoutbosch, Centurion, that develops scientifically formulated products for animal health and human health. Its animal range includes the VYE Drink, Poultry Tonic, Aqua-Blok, Super Boost and Crypto Paste, formulated for poultry, cattle, calves and sheep. Its human health range, including First Guard, uses the same pharmaceutical-grade ingredients and nano-technology as the animal products.

The group also offers contract manufacturing and research and development, and it describes its NanoXome nano-technology as central to its innovation. Its website says its products are engineered to improve lives naturally and effectively, by enhancing performance, nutrition and overall wellbeing. Ashkan suits farmers, animal health buyers and people looking for nutritional supplements, and its stockists are listed on the website.

Research has the national Bakers Bin site (founded in Pretoria in 1999, retail shops and bulk wholesale). No Garsfontein shop page or store facts were found, so the description would be chain-level only.

items.description:
Baobab Café and Grill is an African-themed restaurant and grill in Wonderboom Junction, Wonderboom, where guests can sit on the terrace and choose from the main menu, the wine list and the set menu. The kitchen works with grilled meats, burgers, seafood and desserts, and the restaurant can host events and celebrations, which guests can plan and book online.

The Wonderboom Junction restaurant trades Monday to Thursday from 11:30 to 21:00, Friday and Saturday from 11:00 to 21:30, and Sunday from 11:00 to 20:30, with reservations taken through the website. Another branch operates at Menlyn Park in Pretoria, but this one is the Wonderboom Junction shop, G01. It suits diners who want a relaxed evening out with grilled food, a cocktail or a glass of wine, or a setting for a celebration in Wonderboom.

Battery Pro Wierdapark operates on the Duratec Wierdapark site at Raslouw Corner in Wierdapark, and has offered battery sales and service since 2016. Its technicians provide battery testing with state-of-the-art equipment to check battery health, alternator testing to confirm the charging system is working, and battery fitment, where they help customers choose and install the right battery. The shop also sells Duratec batteries.

The team says its expertise and hands-on experience cover all battery and power needs, and it backs its products with a warranty policy listed on the website. Its services are aimed at dependable power for vehicles and power systems, with a focus on customer satisfaction. The shop is in Wierdapark, Centurion, and suits motorists, fleet operators and anyone with a power system who wants testing, fitment and sales from one team.

Bestdrive Silverlakes, trading as Fundi Tyres, is a tyre and vehicle service centre at Hazeldean Square in Silver Lakes, Pretoria. Its range covers car, budget, premium, run-flat, 4x4 all-terrain and mud-terrain, bakkie, SUV, commercial and truck tyres, as well as American inch-size tyres. Services include tyre fitment, batteries, brakes, shocks, suspension repairs, wheel alignment, wheel balancing and tyre repairs.

The business is one of two Fundi Tyres branches, the other being in Bryanston, and it runs tyre specials and publishes delivery policies for customers who buy online. It says it is committed to genuine customer relationships and offers guarantees on its services. The centre suits drivers in Silver Lakes, Hazeldean and the wider Pretoria East area who want tyres bought, fitted and checked in one place.

BFree Events is the master organiser within the BFree Group, which says it has 25 years of experience in delivering events. It creates and runs events for clients across South Africa and offers turnkey solutions that include staffing, equipment, logistics, ticketing and on-site coordination. Its sister companies, BFree Services, BFree Supplies, Ezitix and BClick, supply the wider network.

The company describes its approach as hands-on and future-focused, with a team prepared to deliver results that exceed expectations. Its founders bring more than a decade of leadership in high-pressure environments, which the company credits for its strategic operations and client relations. The events business is based on Ben Swart Street in Moregloed, Pretoria, and suits organisers who want one partner to handle the logistics of a large event.

Black and Orange Creative is an integrated marketing agency in Pretoria that offers advertising, branding, digital advertising, printing, signage, vehicle branding and wrapping, website design and content creation. The team brings its full range of in-house services together, so a campaign can move from strategy and design to physical signage and vehicle graphics. The agency has been providing branding services for more than 10 years.

It describes itself as results-driven and focused on engaging audiences with creative, holistic campaigns, including online marketing and social media campaigns. Its branding work covers companies of all sizes, and it has designed brands from scratch with long-term corporate identities. The agency's signage and printing work is based in The Willows, Pretoria East, and it suits businesses that want advertising and physical brand work from one supplier.

Blackdot Energy is a solar and renewable energy company that designs, installs and maintains systems for businesses, institutions and property owners across South Africa. Its services include engineering consultation, EPC compliance certification, and accredited training programmes that teach staff to manage and maintain renewable energy systems. Its project list includes a carbon-neutral innovation centre for Vodafone, a hybrid system at a Standard Bank branch in Braamfontein, a municipal solar project for Tshwane and an off-grid lodge.

The company's projects also range from a hotel heat-recovery system and mining energy work to a development bank building and a solar academy, showing that its work covers commercial, mining and off-grid applications. It offers a free consultation for businesses, developers and property owners who want their options explained in plain language. Each project gets a tailor-made plan rather than a standard package. The business is based in Florauna, Pretoria, and suits organisations that want clean power designed around their energy use and savings targets.

Blue Pea Marketing is a marketing agency in Wingate Park offering graphic design, WordPress web design, search engine optimisation, content marketing and paid advertising on Google and social media. Its services begin with a strategy session, where the agency explores the business, audience and goals, and then produces a custom marketing roadmap with competitor and market analysis and a full action plan.

The agency designs custom logos, brand style guides and business stationery, and builds WordPress sites in one-page, five-page or e-commerce formats, with mobile responsiveness, contact forms and Google Analytics. Its stated aim is to help businesses grow by building brand awareness and improving Google ranking. It is based on Swavel Street in Wingate Park, Pretoria, and suits small businesses that want strategy and online marketing handled together.

BKK Multi Services, listed here as Bokang Multi Services, is a Pretoria West business established in 2020 that manufactures custom furniture on site, including doors, units, couches, tables and steel work. Its woodworking roots expanded into upholstery soon after it was formed, and it now offers a full solution for home furnishing. It also resells labelling machines.

The business says it does not outsource any of its work to third parties, which keeps costs down for customers. It manufactures to client specifications and also keeps standard items available. A showroom in Moloto, Mpumalanga, lets customers see products in a home setting before they buy. The workshop is at Rebecca Street in Pretoria West, and the business suits homeowners and offices that want affordable, locally made furniture.

items.description:
Brinant Group, trading as Brinant Security, is a private security company serving Pretoria and surrounding areas. It offers 24/7 armed response with dedicated patrol teams, alarm systems with verified response, off-site monitoring of CCTV, video analytics and licence plate recognition, and guarding and armed escorts. The company also provides anti-land invasion services and technical installations.

It says it has more than 30 years in business, an average response time of about ten minutes in metro areas, and a control room with 99.97% uptime, with PSIRA-registered officers on duty. Google reviews describe a responsive mobile team and security staff who make residents feel safe in their complexes. Based in Moreleta Park, Pretoria, it suits homeowners, estates and businesses that want armed response and monitoring from one provider.

Bronberg Dynamics is a general engineering company that specialises in aerospace and unmanned aircraft systems, designing and building custom UAVs for commercial clients. Its two in-house designs are the Boerperd helicopter drone, which uses a gas motor for long endurance and carries payloads of up to 5 kilograms, and the BATAK VTOL, a lightweight vertical take-off drone named after the Batak pony of Indonesia.

The company says both aircraft can be customised for surveillance, security, mining and agriculture, and its range also includes a coaxial helicopter UAV. Its work covers engineering analysis across multiple disciplines, with a primary focus on aerospace projects. Based near Pretoria, in Zwavelpoort, Bronberg Dynamics suits organisations that need custom unmanned aircraft or engineering analysis for an aerospace or industrial application.

items.description:
Business Data Communication is a supplier of interactive teaching technology and audio-visual equipment, operating since 2000 and serving education and business clients across Africa. Its brands include the Mimio interactive teaching range, with Mimio Teach, Connect, View, Studio and Mobile, and it also supplies Aver, Viisan, Yaber, Echo smart pens, Sunvote assessment keypads and CleverTouch displays.

The company supplies classroom solutions to schools, universities and colleges, and conferencing and boardroom equipment to corporate clients. It says its clients from small schools to large companies receive competitive prices and after-sales service, and it offers free generic lessons for Mimio users. The business is based in Centurion, and it suits educators and businesses that want interactive classroom and meeting technology sourced and supported in one place.
